text: Sure; that's the idea; champagne taste and beer income; and make sure that we never will have more than a beer income, too!” “Are you by any chance implying that I am not economical?” “Well, I hadn't intended to, but since you bring it up yourself, I don't mind saying the grocery bills are about twice what they ought to be.” “Yes, they probably are. I'm not economical. Thanks to you!” “Where d' you get that 'thanks to you'?” “Please don't be quite so colloquial--or shall I say VULGAR?” “I'll be as damn colloquial as I want to. How do you get that 'thanks to you'? Here about a year ago you jump me for not remembering to give you money.
